claimed: Round-1 lead: BMS receives a 22% Winrevair royalty from Merck
page_said: Confirmed (10-K p.90; 10-Q p.11): $289M in 2025, $255M in H1 2026. Reconciliation: 22% x Merck 2025 Winrevair $1,443M = $317M vs $289M booked by BMS (the gap was logged in round 1). For H1 2026, Merck's H1 2026 Winrevair of $1,114M (MRK 10-Q 2026Q2 p.37) x 22% = $245M vs $255M booked, so BMS now books more than implied. The direction of the gap flipped, which suggests timing or true-ups.
action: Used as the partial offset in the BMY-nugget-001 peer note. Not double counted: it sits in revenue, not OI&E.
